method: Pair each request_attempt with the next POST request record having the same path and canonical JSON body, restricted to the completed competition ID. Subtract the recorded epoch timestamps.
limitations: This measures journal attempt-to-recorded-response time, not exchange fill latency.
It excludes earlier decision, queue, guard, reconciliation, and later hedge delays.
The updated ownership checks were not part of this runtime and may add reconciliation time.
One completed season does not establish a stable latency distribution.
